backlog.spec: Introduce a 'gamma' parameter that switches between standard Adam (beta2) and a momentum-squared variant (beta2^2) every N steps (e.g., N=50). This smooths oscillations in the optimization landscape and often improves convergence speed.

backlog.spec: Replace global gradient norm clipping with a batch-dimension clip: clip the norm of the gradient tensor along batch dimensions (batchwise grad clipping) before averaging. This stabilizes training when microbatches differ significantly in loss contribution.

backlog.spec: Apply weight decay per layer based on the layer's position: layers with higher residual degrees (e.g., residual layers) receive higher weight decay (e.g., 0.5 * WEIGHT_DECAY), while core layers receive less decay. This promotes convergence of complex residual paths.

backlog.spec: Enable second-level backpropagation for safety-critical layers (e.g., first 2 layers: skip SBO; last 2 layers: apply SBO) to improve training consistency and accuracy without the overhead of full SBO.

backlog.spec: Perform a warmup phase using uncheckpointed training for the first 10% of steps, then switch to checkpointing. This stabilizes early training and performs well in the later stages.
